sections.title: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge

rows.label: Personal income tax (gelir vergisi), national
rows.value: Residents on worldwide income, non-residents on Turkish income; 15% to 40% in five steps (GVK art. 103)

rows.label: Stamp tax on wages (damga vergisi), national
rows.value: 0.759% of gross pay, deducted by the employer; minimum-wage part exempt (DVK)

source.title: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: 488 sayılı Damga Vergisi Kanunu, (1) sayılı tablo, IV. Makbuzlar ve diğer kâğıtlar, 1-b

rows.label: Stamp tax on documents and contracts (damga vergisi), national
rows.value: Rates per mille or fixed amounts by document type (DVK table 1)

source.title: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: 488 sayılı Damga Vergisi Kanunu, (1) sayılı tablo, IV. Makbuzlar ve diğer kâğıtlar, 1-b

rows.label: Capital gains (değer artışı kazancı), national
rows.value: Property sold within 5 years and shares: taxed under the non-wage scale (GVK mükerrer art. 80)

source.title: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: 193 sayılı Gelir Vergisi Kanunu, mükerrer madde 80 (değer artışı kazançları)

rows.label: Withholding tax on dividends, interest and rent (stopaj), national
rows.value: Dividends 15%; workplace rent 20%; government bond interest 0% (GVK art. 94, KVK art. 30)

source.title: GİB: Menkul Sermaye İradı Rehberi (2026); Kurumlar Vergisi Kanunu madde 30(3); Gelir Vergisi Kanunu mükerrer madde 20/B

rows.label: Withholding tax on deposit interest, national
rows.value: Turkish-lira deposits 10% to 17.5% by term; foreign-currency deposits 25% (GVK temporary art. 67)

source.title: GİB: G.V.K. Geçici 67'nci Madde Vergi Rehberi (February 2026), section 16 'Mevduat faizleri'

rows.label: Rental income, national
rows.value: Taxed under the non-wage scale; housing rent of up to TRY 58,000 a year exempt (GVK art. 21)

source.title: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: 193 sayılı Gelir Vergisi Kanunu, madde 21 (2026 amount from Gelir Vergisi Genel Tebliği Seri No: 332)

rows.label: Non-resident employment income, national
rows.value: Turkish-source wages taxed by withholding under the wage scale (GVK art. 6 and 94)

source.title: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: 193 sayılı Gelir Vergisi Kanunu, madde 3–7 (tam ve dar mükellefiyet)

rows.label: Foreign-income exemption for new residents, national
rows.value: Foreign income exempt for 20 years (GVK mükerrer art. 20/D)

source.title: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: Gelir Vergisi Kanunu, mükerrer madde 20/D (Law 7582, 21 May 2026); GİB: Veraset ve İntikal Vergisi Broşürü (September 2026)

rows.label: Social security contributions (SGK), national
rows.value: Employee 15%, employer 23.75% including unemployment insurance (Law 5510, Law 4447)

source.title: SGK: İşveren Prim Oranları (13 January 2026); Law 5510 art. 81 (as amended by Law 7566); Law 4447 art. 49

rows.label: Unemployment insurance premium (işsizlik sigortası), national
rows.value: Employee 1%, employer 2%, state 1% (Law 4447 art. 49)

source.title: SGK: İşveren Prim Oranları (13 January 2026); Law 5510 art. 81 (as amended by Law 7566); Law 4447 art. 49

rows.label: Private pension auto-enrolment (otomatik katılım), national
rows.value: Employees under 45 enrolled by the employer; 3% of insurable earnings from the employee, opt-out within 2 months (Law 4632 ek madde 2)

source.title: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: 4632 sayılı Bireysel Emeklilik Tasarruf ve Yatırım Sistemi Kanunu, ek madde 2

rows.label: Self-employed contributions (Bağ-Kur), national
rows.value: 35.75% of declared earnings, 30.75% with the on-time discount (Law 5510 art. 81)

source.title: Sosyal Güvenlik Kurumu: Bağımsız Çalışanların Prim Tahakkuk ve Tahsilat İşlemleri (11 May 2026); 5510 sayılı Kanun madde 81(g) and (j)

rows.label: Corporate tax (kurumlar vergisi), national
rows.value: 25%; 30% for financial companies; domestic minimum 10%; global minimum top-up 15% (KVK)

source.title: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: 5520 sayılı Kurumlar Vergisi Kanunu, madde 32, 32/C, 30 and ek madde 6

rows.label: Branch profits remittance tax, national
rows.value: 15% on profits a branch sends to its foreign head office (KVK art. 30(6))

source.title: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: 5520 sayılı Kurumlar Vergisi Kanunu, madde 32, 32/C, 30 and ek madde 6

rows.label: Simplified regime for small traders (basit usul), national
rows.value: Income exempt from income tax under purchase, sales and rent caps (GVK art. 20/A, 46–48)

source.title: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: 193 sayılı Gelir Vergisi Kanunu, madde 47, 48 and mükerrer 20/A (2026 amounts from Gelir Vergisi Genel Tebliği Seri No: 332)

rows.label: Young-entrepreneur exemption, national
rows.value: TRY 400,000 of business income exempt a year for 3 years (GVK mükerrer art. 20)

source.title: Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı: Genç Girişimcilere Vergi Teşviki (March 2026, publication no. 599); 193 sayılı Gelir Vergisi Kanunu mükerrer madde 20

rows.label: Value added tax (katma değer vergisi), national
rows.value: 20% general, 10% and 1% reduced, set by Presidential decision (KDV Law art. 28); see the VAT section

source.title: GİB: Güncel KDV Oranları (rate decision 2007/13033, consolidated to Decision 9126 of 14 November 2024); KDV Kanunu madde 1 and 28

rows.label: Special consumption tax (özel tüketim vergisi, ÖTV), national
rows.value: Amounts and rates in 4 lists: fuels, vehicles, alcohol and tobacco, other goods (Law 4760 art. 12)

source.title: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: 4760 sayılı Özel Tüketim Vergisi Kanunu, madde 12 and lists (I)–(IV)

rows.label: Digital services tax (dijital hizmet vergisi), national
rows.value: 5% in 2026 (7.5% in the law; 2.5% from 2027) on revenue from digital services (Law 7194)

source.title: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: 7194 sayılı Dijital Hizmet Vergisi ile Bazı Kanunlarda ve 375 Sayılı Kanun Hükmünde Kararnamede Değişiklik Yapılması Hakkında Kanun, madde 5 (footnote: Presidential Decision no. 10767, Resmî Gazete 25 December 2025)

rows.label: Banking and insurance transactions tax (BSMV), national
rows.value: Rate in the law 15%, with lower rates set by Presidential decision (Gider Vergileri Kanunu art. 33)

source.title: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: 6802 sayılı Gider Vergileri Kanunu, madde 34 (Konaklama vergisi), and madde 33 (banka ve sigorta muameleleri vergisi)

rows.label: Special communication tax (özel iletişim vergisi), national
rows.value: 10% of mobile, internet, satellite and cable TV and other electronic communication services (7.5% in the law); TRY 700 on a new mobile line, 2026 (Gider Vergileri Kanunu art. 39)

source.title: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: 6802 sayılı Gider Vergileri Kanunu, madde 39 and footnotes 21–22

rows.label: Accommodation tax (konaklama vergisi), national
rows.value: 2% of the price of overnight stays and services sold with them, outside the VAT base (Gider Vergileri Kanunu art. 34)

source.title: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: 6802 sayılı Gider Vergileri Kanunu, madde 34 (Konaklama vergisi), and madde 33 (banka ve sigorta muameleleri vergisi)

rows.label: Property tax (emlak vergisi), municipal
rows.value: Homes 0.1%, other buildings 0.2%, land 0.1%, plots 0.3% of tax value; doubled in metropolitan areas (EVK)

source.title: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: 1319 sayılı Emlak Vergisi Kanunu, madde 8 and 18

rows.label: High-value residence tax (değerli konut vergisi), national
rows.value: 0.3% to 1% on homes valued above TRY 17,711,000 (EVK art. 42–44)

source.title: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: 1319 sayılı Emlak Vergisi Kanunu, madde 42 and 44 (2026 amounts from Emlak Vergisi Kanunu Genel Tebliği Seri No: 88); GİB: Değerli Konut Vergisi Rehberi (February 2026)

rows.label: Title-deed fee on property sales (tapu harcı), national
rows.value: 2% from the seller and 2% from the buyer (Harçlar Kanunu table 4)

source.title: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: 492 sayılı Harçlar Kanunu, (4) sayılı tarife (tapu ve kadastro harçları), 20-a

rows.label: Inheritance and gift tax (veraset ve intikal vergisi), national
rows.value: Inheritance 1% to 10%, gifts 10% to 30%, prizes 20% (Law 7338)

source.title: Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı: Veraset ve İntikal Vergisi Broşürü (September 2026, publication no. 617)

rows.label: Motor vehicle tax (motorlu taşıtlar vergisi), national
rows.value: Annual fixed amounts by vehicle type, engine size, age and value, raised 18.95% for 2026 (Law 197)

source.title: Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı: Motorlu Taşıtlar Vergisi ve Trafik Para Cezası Rehberi (2026); 197 sayılı Motorlu Taşıtlar Vergisi Kanunu

rows.label: Communication tax (haberleşme vergisi), municipal
rows.value: 1% (Belediye Gelirleri Kanunu art. 32)

source.title: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: 2464 sayılı Belediye Gelirleri Kanunu, madde 12–44 (municipal taxes) and 52–70 (municipal fees)

rows.label: Electricity and gas consumption tax, municipal
rows.value: Electricity 1% (industrial uses) or 5%; gas 5% (art. 38)

source.title: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: 2464 sayılı Belediye Gelirleri Kanunu, madde 12–44 (municipal taxes) and 52–70 (municipal fees)

rows.label: Fire insurance tax (yangın sigortası vergisi), municipal
rows.value: 10% of fire insurance premiums (art. 43)

source.title: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: 2464 sayılı Belediye Gelirleri Kanunu, madde 12–44 (municipal taxes) and 52–70 (municipal fees)

rows.label: Environmental cleaning tax (çevre temizlik vergisi), municipal
rows.value: Homes: per cubic metre of water used; workplaces: fixed annual amounts by building group, 25% higher in metropolitan areas (art. 44)

source.title: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: 2464 sayılı Belediye Gelirleri Kanunu, madde 12–44 (municipal taxes) and 52–70 (municipal fees)

rows.label: Advertising tax and entertainment tax, municipal
rows.value: Fixed amounts and rates set in the law and by municipal councils (art. 12–22)

source.title: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: 2464 sayılı Belediye Gelirleri Kanunu, madde 12–44 (municipal taxes) and 52–70 (municipal fees)

rows.label: Business-opening permit fee (işyeri açma izni harcı), municipal
rows.value: One-off fee per square metre when a workplace opens, within the ranges in the law (Belediye Gelirleri Kanunu art. 81)

source.title: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: 2464 sayılı Belediye Gelirleri Kanunu, madde 12–44 (municipal taxes) and 52–70 (municipal fees)

rows.label: Brokerage fee (tellallık harcı), municipal
rows.value: 2% on sales through municipal brokers (art. 70)

source.title: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: 2464 sayılı Belediye Gelirleri Kanunu, madde 12–44 (municipal taxes) and 52–70 (municipal fees)

rows.label: Customs duties and import taxes, national
rows.value: Duty by tariff line on the customs value; no low-value exemption; flat-rate taxes for some personal imports (see the customs section)

source.title: Ticaret Bakanlığı: Posta ve Hızlı Kargo Muafiyeti FAQ (5 March 2026); customs circular 2026/4

rows.label: Departure fee (yurt dışına çıkış harcı), national
rows.value: TRY 1,250 per departure for Turkish citizens, 2026; residents abroad and children under 7 are exempt (Law 5597)

source.title: GİB: Yurt Dışına Çıkış Harcı (May 2026); Law 5597 art. 1

rows.label: TRT device levy (TRT bandrol ücreti), national
rows.value: One-off levy on devices that receive broadcasts, on the VAT base at sale or import: televisions and radios 8%, video 12%, mobile phones 6%, computers and tablets 2%, other devices 10% (rates in Law 3093 art. 4; the President may change them)

source.title: Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: 3093 sayılı Türkiye Radyo-Televizyon Kurumu Gelirleri Kanunu, madde 3 and 4

rows.label: Mobile phone registration fee, national
rows.value: TRY 54,258 for a phone brought from abroad (Harçlar Kanunu table 8, VIII)

source.title: Ticaret Bakanlığı: Yolcu Muafiyetleri FAQ (3 March 2026); Harçlar Kanunu tariff 8, VIII (2026 amount: Genel Tebliğ Seri No: 98)
Mevzuat Bilgi Sistemi: 193 sayılı Gelir Vergisi Kanunu, madde 103 (2026 amounts: Gelir Vergisi Genel Tebliği Seri No: 332); GİB: Ücret Geliri Rehberi (February 2026), 4.7
